description: Critical endpoint for processing SKU models via URL. Implements SkuService class for remote URL fetching with SSRF vulnerability. POST endpoint requiring URL parameter.
notes: CRITICAL: Fetches remote content via URL using file_get_contents(). Validates URL format and port 4455 requirement, but implementation has SSRF bypass potential. Maps localhost/127.0.0.1 to 'skumodel' hostname. Uses stream context for POST requests.
